`create_model` computes `flat_snapshots` and flattens the snapshots stored in `n.model.parameters`, but never converts its local `sns` to a flat index. Consequently, for multi-period networks with `"flat"` (or `"auto"` under v1 semantics), it still passes a MultiIndex to the variable and constraint builders, regardless of `transmission_losses`; the component-data context does not change that argument.
